svg.title: Nautix transaction flow: a private transfer sent by a relayer
svg.desc: Sequence diagram with four lifelines: the sender's device, the relayer, the pool on chain and the auditor. The device builds the transaction and proves it, hands the proven request to the relayer, the relayer sends it to the pool, the pool checks the root, the amounts, the nullifiers and the proof, then applies the change and emits its events. The sender's client reads the new commitments and nullifiers; the auditor opens the sealed record.
svg.text: A private transfer, sent by a relayer
Deposits and withdrawals take the same path. Only the public amount and the payee differ.
